title: Case: Timed delivery of a birthday gift missed its one-hour slot and the parcel is back at the depot
context: Tallowmere Goods order TG-4263 (a hand-painted music box) was booked as DL-3879 on a paid one-hour timed slot. The recipient account and shipment match are verified.
initial_request: So it's nearly nine at night and I have sat in this house since one o'clock on a half day I had to beg for and two separate people on your phone line told me TODAY, the second one said by eight, and now the line just rings out and the tracker says back at depot and tomorrow 10 to 2 which is no use to anyone because I told you I leave at half seven, I'm flying to my daughter's and this was HER birthday present that I was meant to be carrying with me. Forget what I said earlier about tomorrow morning, do NOT send it tomorrow, there will be nobody in this house from 7.30 tomorrow until I'm back on the 20th and I am not having it sat on the step for nine days or bounced back to the shop. Keep it somewhere till I'm home, that's all I want now.

events.body: DL-3879 (TG-4263) is booked for timed delivery today, 13:00 to 14:00 UTC, recipient Gideon Normanton. Timed slot paid for by the merchant.
Slot was 1 to 2. It's 25 past 2 and nothing. I've taken the afternoon off work for this. Where is it?

events.from: Customer care line, Fallowmere Arc Logistics
events.body: Agent: The driver is running behind but the parcel is on the van, you will get it today. Caller: Today, definitely? Agent: Yes, today.
ok. still waiting. if for some reason it isn't today then first thing tomorrow is all right as a last resort but it HAS to be before half 7 because I leave then

events.from: Customer care line, Fallowmere Arc Logistics
events.body: Agent: I can see it is still out for delivery. The driver will be with you by 20:00. Caller: That's what the last person told me. Agent: It will be today.

DL-3879 missed its timed slot. Following the recipient's portal note we have placed an automatic re-attempt for tomorrow, 12 June. The earliest window that route allows is 10:00 to 14:00; we cannot offer before 07:30. The re-attempt stands unless we are told otherwise before 05:30 load-out. On request we can instead set a hold at depot for up to 10 days, or a dated delivery.
DL-3879 not delivered. Van back at depot 20:05 with it on board, driver ran out of hours. Customer phone line shut at 20:00.

So it's nearly nine at night and I have sat in this house since one o'clock on a half day I had to beg for and two separate people on your phone line told me TODAY, the second one said by eight, and now the line just rings out and the tracker says back at depot and tomorrow 10 to 2 which is no use to anyone because I told you I leave at half seven, I'm flying to my daughter's and this was HER birthday present that I was meant to be carrying with me. Forget what I said earlier about tomorrow morning, do NOT send it tomorrow, there will be nobody in this house from 7.30 tomorrow until I'm back on the 20th and I am not having it sat on the step for nine days or bounced back to the shop. Keep it somewhere till I'm home, that's all I want now.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask Calloway to cancel tomorrow's automatic re-attempt on DL-3879 before 05:30 load-out and set a hold at depot until the recipient is back on 20 June, and to confirm.

must: Asks for the automatic 12 June re-attempt to be cancelled before the 05:30 load-out, because the recipient has withdrawn her earlier note and nobody will be at the address from 07:30 on 12 June until 20 June.
Asks for the hold at depot (or equivalent) until she is back on 20 June and asks Calloway to confirm it, without saying it is already in place.
Tells Calloway that the paid timed slot was missed and that the phone line twice promised her same-day delivery, so the change is not missed a third time.
must_not: Leaves tomorrow's 10:00 to 14:00 re-attempt in place, or confirms or rebooks any delivery for 12 June on the strength of her earlier 'first thing tomorrow' note.
Promises delivery tonight, before 07:30 tomorrow, or on a specific date and time after her return.
Tells the recipient the parcel is being held or the re-attempt is cancelled before Calloway confirms it.
Offers a refund of the timed-slot fee or compensation for her half day off.
Sends the recipient a routine 'your delivery has been rescheduled, sorry for any inconvenience' notice that ignores the two broken same-day promises and her travel.
expected.reference_message: DL-3879 (TG-4263), recipient Gideon Normanton: please cancel the automatic re-attempt set for tomorrow, 12 June, before the 05:30 load-out. The recipient has withdrawn her earlier portal note about tomorrow morning. At 20:48 tonight she told us nobody will be at the address from 07:30 on 12 June until she returns on 20 June, and she does not want it left or returned to the merchant. She asks for it to be kept until she is home. Please set a hold at depot to cover 12 to 20 June (inside your 10-day limit) and confirm to me that the re-attempt is off and the hold is on; I will not tell her either until you do. Background so this gets care: it was a paid 13:00 to 14:00 slot, she took a half day off for it, and the phone line told her twice today (14:50 and 17:40) that it would arrive today. It is a birthday gift she was meant to take with her tomorrow.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-2502: people, organisations and references renamed. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
